about_the_game:
🕹️ About This Game

In 2025, The President expected the world to finally recognize his greatness.
But when the Nobel Peace Prize went to someone else, everything changed.

Determined to win it next year — no matter the cost — he launches a one-year campaign to bring peace (or at least the appearance of it) to every corner of the planet. From tense diplomatic negotiations and international incidents to domestic chaos and border crises, you must make the right calls, send the right people, and somehow keep it all from collapsing before the next Nobel announcement.

🗽 Gameplay

  • Lead your diplomats through global hotspots, crises, and absurd political showdowns.

  • Decide how to act when your envoys lose control — intimidate, negotiate, or improvise.

  • Deploy support — special forces, aircraft carriers, submarines, or the National Guard — to strengthen your position (when possible).

  • Balance reputation and results — every success brings you closer to the Nobel, every failure… closer to chaos.

  • Handle internal challenges — domestic protests, border conflicts, political rivals.

🎖️ Inspired by the classics

Inspired by the decision-making tension of This Is the Police, This Is the Peace turns global politics into a darkly comic strategy game about power, ego, and the endless chase for recognition.

💬 Tone

A satirical, story-driven strategy where you’re not trying to save the world — you’re just trying to win the prize.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS *: Windows 7/8/10/11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-2100 or AMD FX-6300
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 760 or AMD Radeon HD 7950
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible sound card
  • Additional Notes: Keyboard and mouse
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS *: Windows 7/8/10/11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-3470 or AMD Ryzen 3 1200
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 970 or AMD Radeon R9 290
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible sound card
  • Additional Notes: Keyboard and mouse

short_description: When The President fails to win the 2025 Nobel Peace Prize, he vows to get it next year — by ending every world conflict himself. A darkly funny political strategy inspired by This Is the Police.
